package.name: ammo_gui_node
package.description: Operator GUI: mission setup (working area, autonomous/manual mode), live mission progress, mushroom count, elapsed time, pause/resume, manual keyboard teleop of the Parrot, and an occupancy-grid map view with robot pose/heading and mushroom markers. Separate from ammo_dashboard's read-only debug HUD - this one is an interactive PySide6 control surface.
